findings.summary: Barrel re-exports from '../modules/auth/schema.ts' with a literal .ts extension; under NodeNext+verbatimModuleSyntax tsc -b fails with TS5097 (allowImportingTsExtensions is not set).
findings.suggested_fix: Change line 1 to `export * from '../modules/auth/schema.js';` — same .js convention used by shared/logger.ts and modules/auth/tokens.ts. Re-run `pnpm --filter @medbridge/api typecheck` to confirm zero TS5097 errors.

findings.summary: `refreshToken` self-references via `replacedBy` -> refreshToken.id without an explicit type annotation, producing TS7022 / TS7024 (implicit any on a recursive initializer). Breaks tsc -b for apps/api.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an explicit table type annotation, e.g. `export const refreshToken: PgTableWithColumns<...> = pgTable(...)` OR split the self-FK out via an `addForeignKey`-style follow-up. Simpler fix: split into two-step table definition or annotate the const. Confirm with `pnpm --filter @medbridge/api typecheck`.

findings.summary: authn imports the eager `env` singleton from shared/env.ts and reads `env.JWT_SECRET` at request time; perpetuates the wave-3 F-001 / wave-4 F-002 eager-load anti-pattern and defeats buildApp(env) DI in wave-7/9.
findings.suggested_fix: Accept `jwtSecret` (or the whole `Env`) via a middleware factory: `export function authn(jwtSecret: string): MiddlewareHandler`. Compose in main.ts (wave-9) once env is loaded. Same posture as the wave-4 F-002 db/client.ts fix that is still pending.

findings.summary: STATE_CHANGING_METHODS includes PUT, but ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4 specifies only POST/PATCH/DELETE require CSRF; the task description also lists POST/PATCH/DELETE only.
findings.suggested_fix: Either drop 'PUT' from the Set to match the architecture spec, or amend ARCHITECTURE.md §5.4 / the task description to record that PUT is intentionally guarded. The RPC-style route convention (verb in path) means PUT is never used in practice, so removing it is the lower-risk fix.

findings.summary: `const userRole = user.role as string` casts `user` (typed as unknown via c.get) without consulting the SessionPayload schema; if a future authn change drops `role`, this silently coerces undefined to the string 'undefined'.
findings.suggested_fix: Either (a) declare a Hono `Variables` type for the app context that types `user` as SessionPayload, or (b) zod-parse `c.get('user')` against the existing sessionPayloadSchema before reading `.role`. Option (a) is the cleaner long-term fix.

findings.summary: `err.status as 422` casts to a single literal HTTP status, which is incorrect for non-422 AppError subclasses (401/403/404/409/413/415/500); the cast happens to compile but misrepresents the value to readers.
findings.suggested_fix: Cast to Hono's `ContentfulStatusCode` (from `hono/utils/http-status`) instead: `err.status as ContentfulStatusCode`. Removes the misleading 422 literal while keeping the assignment type-safe.

findings.summary: Migration `when` timestamp is 1747353600000 (2025-05-16), one year before today (2026-05-16); drizzle-kit typically stamps the generation time. Cosmetic but inconsistent with reality.
findings.suggested_fix: On the next drizzle-kit generate run the timestamp will be regenerated. No action this wave unless migration ordering is challenged later.
